sections.title: Profile
paragraphs: Two or three sentences about what you do, the kind of problems you like, and the outcome you are known for. Keep it specific; this paragraph is the first thing a reader scans.

entries.title: Example Studio
entries.subtitle: Senior Product Designer
bullets: Lead with the result, then the work that produced it. One or two lines per point reads best.
Use **bold** sparingly for the product or platform a recruiter should notice.
Name the scope you owned: research, interaction design, design system, delivery.

entries.title: Previous Company
entries.subtitle: Product Designer
bullets: Describe one shipped project and what changed for its users.
Mention the people and disciplines you worked with.

entries.title: Side Project — What it is in a few words
bullets: Why it exists and who uses it.

items.label: Tools
items.value: Figma, HTML, CSS, a little TypeScript
